policy.admission: Curator titles, row hints and notes are discovery/test inputs only. They never bypass the ordinary A/B source-quality, EU relevance, R&I substance, strategic-context, language, date or document gates.
policy.matrix: Frontier row hints never force a Matrix cell. Only source-derived admitted Strand-A evidence may be classified by the existing browser Matrix semantic contract.
policy.companions: Bundled 'And/With' publications are split into independent candidate works and resolved by exact title when no DOI was supplied in the source document.
